title: The finite forget-support equation for a normalized strict Cartier class
statement: Let l be prime, Y and its projective line and diagonal surface noetherian, l invertible on Y, and use the surface localization conventions. Let D be an ordinary strict reduction presentation, H a strict root system, xi in Ext²(D.E(diagonalIntegralSource),H), and assume diagonalFiniteCycleNormalization for xi with the positive canonical Cartier class at every exponent n+1 [det-prop-diagonal-tower-limit]. Let s be the ordinary completed supported-source limit isomorphism satisfying the integral-generator equation. Let c be normalized Chern data with FiniteChernNormalization, r a scalar restriction, k its normalized coefficient cones, and e:H≅r.F(lineModule(c)) whose underlying map is roots.hom≫k.lineForget.inv. For arbitrary presentations a:K≅single(D.E(diagonalIntegralSource)), b:J≅single(H)[2], and f:K→J with xi.hom=a.inv≫f≫b.hom, and any derived-limit models L0,L, evaluate the source-limit comparison at n, precompose completedSupportedUnit, apply f and rootSystemTransport, and obtain (k.unitMap(L)≫L.projection(n))≫evaluation(D(r.F)(firstChern(diagonalPic(Y)))). The full source, target, and comparisons are fixed by the Lean statement. No completed diagonal arrow or IsDiagonalLimit hypothesis occurs.

proof.text: Apply the source projection theorem using hxi, hs, he and hp. It produces a normalized finite frame and identifies the supported source composite with the fixed reduced Cartier arrow.
The residue Cartier Kummer theorem, a direct specialization of the proved Cartier site comparison, supplies the geometric Chern equation for this reduced class.

Apply the coefficient comparison theorem with hn, hc and that geometric Chern equation. Substitute its equality into the source equation to obtain finiteBoundaryEquation. Use the proved typed assembly lemma to transport the endpoint equality through the named predicates.

theorem diagonalTrace_supportedFiniteBoundary
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [IsNoetherian (diagonalSurface Y)] (hY : IsUnit (l : Γ(Y, ⊤)))
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (D : DiagonalReductionPresentation l (diagonalScalarExtension l (diagonalSurface Y)))
    (H : DiagonalSystems l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (roots : H ⋙ diagonalForget l (diagonalSurface Y) ≅
      Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnityTower (diagonalSurface Y) l (Fact.out : l.Prime))
    (xi : Ext (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) H 2)
    (hxi : FiniteCartierNormalization l Y hY D H roots xi)
    (s : (diagonalCompletedRestriction l (diagonalSurface Y)).obj
        (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≅ limit (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)))
    (hs : SupportedSourceConeNormalization l Y D s)
    (c : SpTowerClasses.Chern l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (hn : c.Normalized l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)))
    (hc : SpTowerClasses.FiniteChernNormalization l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c)
    (r : Restriction l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y))
    (k : Coefficients l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) (diagonalSurface Y) c r)
    (e : H ≅ r.F.obj (SpTowerClasses.lineModule l (ULift.{u} (Padic l)) c))
    (he : Functor.whiskerRight e.hom (diagonalForget l (diagonalSurface Y)) =
      roots.hom ≫ k.lineForget.inv)
    (p : ExtDerivedPresentation (D.E.obj (diagonalIntegralSource Y)) H)
    (hp : p.Presents xi)
    (L₀ L : DiagonalRlim (DiagonalMod l (diagonalSurface Y))) (n : ℕ) :
    finiteBoundaryEquation l Y D H p s c r k e L₀ L n
